# Data Dictionary - marketplace schema

Generated from the built database by `scripts/generate_data_dictionary.sql` (descriptions come from `migrations/007_comments.sql`). All money columns are in US dollars; all timestamps are `timestamp with time zone`.

**Key column:** PK = primary key, UQ = part of a UNIQUE constraint, FK → table = foreign key. **Default "identity":** the value is generated automatically (`GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` or `ALWAYS`).

## Tables

| # | Table | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [`category`](#1-category) | Product categories used to organize the catalog. |
| 2 | [`seller`](#2-seller) | Businesses that list products on the marketplace. |
| 3 | [`customer`](#3-customer) | People with a shopping account. |
| 4 | [`address`](#4-address) | Saved shipping addresses of a customer. Rows used by an order are never edited or deleted; they are retired with is_active = FALSE. Protected by row-level security. |
| 5 | [`product`](#5-product) | A product listed by one seller in one category. |
| 6 | [`product_variant`](#6-product_variant) | A sellable size/color version of a product (weak entity identified by product and SKU). |
| 7 | [`order_header`](#7-order_header) | A customer order. The customer is reached through the shipping address (BCNF). |
| 8 | [`order_item`](#8-order_item) | One line of an order: a variant, a quantity and the price paid. |
| 9 | [`payment`](#9-payment) | Payments and refunds against an order. An order can have several (split payment, refund). |
| 10 | [`review`](#10-review) | A customer's rating of a product; at most one per customer per product. |
| 11 | [`seller_payout`](#11-seller_payout) | Money the marketplace pays a seller for their items on one order; at most one payout per seller per order. |
| 12 | [`variant_audit`](#12-variant_audit) | Audit log written by trigger trg_variant_audit for every change to a variant's stock or price override. No foreign keys, so history survives deletes. |
| 13 | [`app_user`](#13-app_user) | Maps each customer database login role to its customer, for the row-level security policy on address. Protected by its own policy. |

## 1. category

Product categories used to organize the catalog.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `category_name` | character varying(60) | NO |  | UQ | Display name of the category; unique. |

**Constraints**

- `category_name_uq`: UNIQUE (category_name)

## 2. seller

Businesses that list products on the marketplace.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seller_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `business_name` | character varying(120) | NO |  |  | Legal or trading name shown to customers. |
| `contact_email` | character varying(254) | NO |  | UQ | Seller contact email; unique. |
| `phone` | character varying(20) | yes |  |  | Seller contact phone number (optional). |
| `approval_status` | character varying(12) | NO | 'pending'::character varying |  | pending, approved, suspended or rejected. Only approved sellers appear in the storefront. |

**Constraints**

- `seller_status_ck`: CHECK (((approval_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'approved'::character varying, 'suspended'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying])::text[])))
- `seller_email_uq`: UNIQUE (contact_email)

## 3. customer

People with a shopping account.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `first_name` | character varying(50) | NO |  |  | Customer first name. |
| `last_name` | character varying(50) | NO |  |  | Customer last name. |
| `email` | character varying(254) | NO |  | UQ | Login and contact email; unique. |
| `phone` | character varying(20) | yes |  |  | Contact phone number (optional). |

**Constraints**

- `customer_email_uq`: UNIQUE (email)

## 4. address

Saved shipping addresses of a customer. Rows used by an order are never edited or deleted; they are retired with is_active = FALSE. Protected by row-level security.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `customer_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → customer | Customer who owns the address (FK to customer). |
| `label` | character varying(30) | yes |  |  | Customer's name for the address, e.g. Home or Work (optional). |
| `street` | character varying(120) | NO |  |  | Street line, including apartment or suite. |
| `city` | character varying(60) | NO |  |  | City. |
| `state` | character(2) | NO |  |  | Two-letter US state code. |
| `postal_code` | character varying(10) | NO |  |  | ZIP code: 5 digits or ZIP+4. |
| `is_active` | boolean | NO | true |  | FALSE once the address is retired; retired addresses cannot be used for new orders. |

**Constraints**

- `address_postal_ck`: CHECK (((postal_code)::text ~ '^[0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?$'::text))
- `address_state_ck`: CHECK ((state ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text))
- `address_customer_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES marketplace.customer(customer_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

## 5. product

A product listed by one seller in one category.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `seller_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → seller | Seller who lists the product (FK to seller). |
| `category_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → category | Category the product belongs to (FK to category). |
| `product_name` | character varying(150) | NO |  |  | Product name shown in the catalog. |
| `description` | text | yes |  |  | Long description (optional). |
| `base_price` | numeric(10,2) | NO |  |  | Default selling price in USD for all variants. |

**Constraints**

- `product_price_ck`: CHECK ((base_price >= (0)::numeric))
- `product_category_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES marketplace.category(category_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- `product_seller_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES marketplace.seller(seller_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

## 6. product_variant

A sellable size/color version of a product (weak entity identified by product and SKU).

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | integer | NO |  | PK, FK → product, UQ | Product this variant belongs to (FK to product); part of the primary key. |
| `sku` | character varying(40) | NO |  | PK | Stock keeping unit, unique within the product; part of the primary key. |
| `size` | character varying(20) | yes |  | UQ | Size, e.g. M or 45 L (NULL when the product has no sizes). |
| `color` | character varying(30) | yes |  | UQ | Color (NULL when the product has no colors). |
| `stock_quantity` | integer | NO | 0 |  | Units in stock; never negative. Changes are logged in variant_audit. |
| `price_override` | numeric(10,2) | yes |  |  | Variant price in USD that replaces product.base_price; NULL means use the base price. Changes are logged in variant_audit. |
| `reorder_level` | integer | NO | 10 |  | Stock level at or below which the variant should be reordered (default 10). |

**Constraints**

- `product_variant_price_ck`: CHECK (((price_override IS NULL) OR (price_override >= (0)::numeric)))
- `product_variant_reorder_ck`: CHECK ((reorder_level >= 0))
- `product_variant_stock_ck`: CHECK ((stock_quantity >= 0))
- `product_variant_product_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES marketplace.product(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- `product_variant_size_color_uq`: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (product_id, size, color)

## 7. order_header

A customer order. The customer is reached through the shipping address (BCNF).

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key (order number). |
| `address_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → address | Shipping address (FK to address); also identifies the customer. |
| `order_date` | timestamp with time zone | NO | now() |  | Date and time the order was placed. |
| `status` | character varying(12) | NO | 'pending'::character varying |  | pending, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled or refunded. |
| `total_amount` | numeric(12,2) | NO | 0 |  | Order total in USD = SUM(quantity * unit_price) of its lines (see fn_order_total). |

**Constraints**

- `order_header_status_ck`: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'paid'::character varying, 'shipped'::character varying, 'delivered'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])::text[])))
- `order_header_total_ck`: CHECK ((total_amount >= (0)::numeric))
- `order_header_address_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (address_id) REFERENCES marketplace.address(address_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

## 8. order_item

One line of an order: a variant, a quantity and the price paid.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `order_item_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `order_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → order_header, UQ | Order the line belongs to (FK to order_header). |
| `product_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → product_variant, UQ | Product of the variant bought (FK to product_variant with sku). |
| `sku` | character varying(40) | NO |  | FK → product_variant, UQ | SKU of the variant bought (FK to product_variant with product_id). |
| `quantity` | integer | NO |  |  | Units bought; greater than zero. |
| `unit_price` | numeric(10,2) | NO |  |  | Price per unit in USD at checkout (kept even if the catalog price changes later). |

**Constraints**

- `order_item_price_ck`: CHECK ((unit_price >= (0)::numeric))
- `order_item_quantity_ck`: CHECK ((quantity > 0))
- `order_item_order_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES marketplace.order_header(order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- `order_item_variant_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, sku) REFERENCES marketplace.product_variant(product_id, sku) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
- `order_item_variant_uq`: UNIQUE (order_id, product_id, sku)

## 9. payment

Payments and refunds against an order. An order can have several (split payment, refund).

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `order_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → order_header | Order paid for (FK to order_header). |
| `amount` | numeric(12,2) | NO |  |  | Amount in USD; greater than zero. |
| `payment_date` | timestamp with time zone | NO | now() |  | Date and time of the payment. |
| `payment_method` | character varying(20) | NO |  |  | card, paypal, bank_transfer or gift_card. |
| `status` | character varying(12) | NO | 'pending'::character varying |  | pending, completed, failed or refunded. |

**Constraints**

- `payment_amount_ck`: CHECK ((amount > (0)::numeric))
- `payment_method_ck`: CHECK (((payment_method)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['card'::character varying, 'paypal'::character varying, 'bank_transfer'::character varying, 'gift_card'::character varying])::text[])))
- `payment_status_ck`: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])::text[])))
- `payment_order_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES marketplace.order_header(order_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

## 10. review

A customer's rating of a product; at most one per customer per product.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `customer_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → customer, UQ | Customer who wrote the review (FK to customer). |
| `product_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → product, UQ | Product reviewed (FK to product). |
| `rating` | smallint | NO |  |  | Star rating from 1 to 5. |
| `comment` | text | yes |  |  | Review text (optional). |
| `review_date` | timestamp with time zone | NO | now() |  | Date and time the review was posted. |

**Constraints**

- `review_rating_ck`: CHECK (((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 5)))
- `review_customer_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES marketplace.customer(customer_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- `review_product_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES marketplace.product(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- `review_customer_product_uq`: UNIQUE (customer_id, product_id)

## 11. seller_payout

Money the marketplace pays a seller for their items on one order; at most one payout per seller per order.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payout_id` | integer | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key. |
| `seller_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → seller, UQ | Seller being paid (FK to seller). |
| `order_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → order_header, UQ | Order the payout is for (FK to order_header). |
| `gross_amount` | numeric(12,2) | NO |  |  | Seller's sales on the order in USD, before commission. |
| `commission` | numeric(12,2) | NO |  |  | Marketplace commission kept, in USD. |
| `net_amount` | numeric(12,2) | NO |  |  | Amount paid to the seller in USD = gross_amount - commission. |
| `paid_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | Date and time the payout was sent; NULL while it is still owed. |

**Constraints**

- `seller_payout_amounts_ck`: CHECK (((gross_amount >= (0)::numeric) AND (commission >= (0)::numeric) AND (net_amount = (gross_amount - commission))))
- `seller_payout_order_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES marketplace.order_header(order_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- `seller_payout_seller_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES marketplace.seller(seller_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- `seller_payout_seller_order_uq`: UNIQUE (seller_id, order_id)

## 12. variant_audit

Audit log written by trigger trg_variant_audit for every change to a variant's stock or price override. No foreign keys, so history survives deletes.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audit_id` | bigint | NO | identity | PK | Surrogate key, in the order the changes happened. |
| `product_id` | integer | NO |  |  | Product of the changed variant. |
| `sku` | character varying(40) | NO |  |  | SKU of the changed variant. |
| `old_stock_quantity` | integer | yes |  |  | Stock before the change. |
| `new_stock_quantity` | integer | yes |  |  | Stock after the change. |
| `old_price_override` | numeric(10,2) | yes |  |  | Price override before the change. |
| `new_price_override` | numeric(10,2) | yes |  |  | Price override after the change. |
| `changed_by` | text | NO | CURRENT_USER |  | Database role that made the change (current_user). |
| `changed_at` | timestamp with time zone | NO | now() |  | Date and time of the change. |

## 13. app_user

Maps each customer database login role to its customer, for the row-level security policy on address. Protected by its own policy.

| Column | Type | Null? | Default | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role_name` | text | NO |  | PK | PostgreSQL role name of the customer login, e.g. cust_pedro. |
| `customer_id` | integer | NO |  | FK → customer, UQ | Customer the role belongs to (FK to customer); unique. |

**Constraints**

- `app_user_customer_fk`: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES marketplace.customer(customer_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- `app_user_customer_uq`: UNIQUE (customer_id)

## Views

| View | Description |
|---|---|
| `v_order_summary` | One row per order: customer, ship-to city, line and unit counts, sellers involved, total, net paid and balance due. |
| `v_storefront_catalog` | Every variant from approved sellers with its selling price, stock status and product rating. |

## Functions, procedure and trigger

| Object | Kind | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `fn_order_total` | function → numeric | p_order_id integer |
| `fn_seller_payout` | function → numeric | p_seller_id integer, p_from date, p_to date, p_commission_pct numeric DEFAULT 10 |
| `sp_place_order` | procedure | IN p_address_id integer, IN p_items jsonb, IN p_payment_method character varying, INOUT p_order_id integer DEFAULT NULL::integer |
| `trg_fn_variant_audit` | trigger function | (none) |
| `trg_variant_audit` | trigger on `product_variant` | AFTER UPDATE OF stock_quantity, price_override → trg_fn_variant_audit() |

## Security

| Role | Purpose | Access |
|---|---|---|
| `mp_viewer` | Read-only catalog analyst | SELECT on category, product, product_variant, seller, v_storefront_catalog |
| `mp_staff` | Inventory staff | Same SELECT; UPDATE (stock_quantity, price_override) on product_variant; INSERT on variant_audit |
| `mp_customer` | Group role for customer logins | SELECT on address and app_user, filtered by RLS to the customer's own rows |
| `cust_pedro`, `cust_aisha` | Example customer logins (customers 1 and 2) | Members of mp_customer |

| Policy | Table | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `address_owner_only` | address | SELECT to mp_customer USING (customer_id = ( SELECT app_user.customer_id FROM marketplace.app_user WHERE (app_user.role_name = CURRENT_USER))) |
| `app_user_self` | app_user | SELECT to mp_customer USING (role_name = CURRENT_USER) |
